subject.title: Bug: Isolated cron job delivery.mode=announce fails with 'Channel openclaw-weixin does not support action send'

question: Should this issue move to a fix path based on the source-level unsupported-action path, or should maintainers require a live current-main Weixin cron trace first?
rationale: The source explains the reported error and the issue has stable-release confirmation, but current main and v2026.6.10 already contain direct fallback code, so the remaining behavior depends on the exact runtime message-tool/fallback sequence.

options.title: Require focused repro before repair
options.body: Keep this issue open for a live Weixin cron trace or a minimal source regression that shows the unsupported action attempt still causes not-delivered status or lost output.

options.title: Sponsor a generic source-delivery fix
options.body: Ask for a narrow PR that disables or downgrades model-facing message-tool delivery for direct-only external channel announce targets while preserving direct fallback tests.

options.title: Close as external plugin-only
options.body: Close only if maintainers confirm the unsupported action attempt is harmless on current OpenClaw and remaining delivery failure belongs entirely to the external Weixin plugin.

recommendation.title: Require focused repro before repair
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a live Weixin cron trace or a minimal source regression that shows the unsupported action attempt still causes not-delivered status or lost output.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent cross-cutting history across cron delivery, outbound routing, and Gateway send documentation, making them the best available owner for the proof threshold decision.
